propositions: Reconcile Bridge failures running on GitHub Actions produce no CloudWatch signal or alarms, leaving token expirations and auth failures invisible to monitoring
GitHub Actions workflow can publish metrics to CloudWatch via OIDC but the repo currently implements no such publication for bridge run status
A new narrowly-scoped IAM role federating the existing OIDC provider must grant only cloudwatch:PutMetricData constrained to the rebar/host namespace
The reconcile-bridge workflow job must publish bridge_run_failures=1 on failure and bridge_run_failures=0 on success, with metric steps continue-on-error and gated on repo vars

A CloudWatch alarm on rebar/host:bridge_run_failures must alert on the second failure within an hour (period=3600, threshold=1) to distinguish transient blips from sustained outages like expired tokens
